items.title: 68437_Charles Thompson oral history interview
items.q: it was done with Lionel, with a small group of musicians which included first Lee Young

ctx.x: Sir Charles, when you were with Lionel and you were playing the Grand Terrace, you made a record session at that time, didn't you?

Yes, we made a very important record session there, to me, because it was my first professional recording, and it was done with Lionel, with a small group of musicians which included first Lee Young. I believe Lee Young was on some of the records on the drums. You can look this up but also Shadow Wilson came in the band later.
